issuer: the District of Columbia Department of Motor Vehicles (DC DMV)
note: DC DMV's fee page (read 2026-10-30) gives a driver licence, first-time and renewal, at $47 for 8 years and a non-driver ID card at $20 for 8 years (free from 65). The full licence page says a full licence with conditions is had from 17 and lists restrictions for drivers under 18 only, so an unrestricted licence is kept from 18. No youngest age for the card was read.
